options.content:
## The whole story, connected.
**1 Create a run → 2 Open the customer app → 3 Activate one scenario → 4 Follow the evidence → 5 Reset & verify.**

[Open customer experience](http://localhost:3101/control/presenter/customer) · [Local presenter](http://localhost:3101) · [Runtime investigation](/d/pd-runtime) · [Agent quality](/d/pd-agent-quality)

Controls operate on the Mac running this browser. Allow local-network access if prompted. State below is real controller readback exported to Cloud; allow **10–30 seconds** after a click and check freshness.
